issue.title: return_links filter tests pin Pandoc's \hyperref form; Pandoc 3.1.3 emits \hyperlink and 9 tests fail
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bob-cli-5s.1 (note #1) and again by bob-cli-5s.9 (note #2) during epic bob-cli-5s; recorded by bob-cli-5s.land. Not caused by bob-cli-5s: the failing tests and src/native/highlights_ref/return_links.rs come from epic bob-cli-5j (commits d4fab34, 6fb936d, 39915c5, 2026-10-07), and bob-cli-5s never touched that file.

Repro (bob-cli master b6ba7c3, apollo, pandoc 3.1.3): `cargo test --lib return_links` -> 18 passed, 9 failed, deterministically (reproduced by bob-cli-5s.1, bob-cli-5s.9 via git stash on a clean tree, and the land agent).

Failing tests (all in native::highlights_ref::return_links::tests): filter_leaves_image_description_spans_untagged, filter_leaves_non_capable_targets_untagged, filter_leaves_skip_context_links_untagged, filter_numbers_github_duplicates_and_rejects_ambiguous_aliases, filter_places_div_span_and_needspace_rows, filter_prefers_real_ids_over_aliases, filter_resolves_decoded_and_github_aliases, filter_treats_nested_heading_spans_as_skip_contexts, filter_treats_table_head_foot_spans_as_skip_contexts.

Root cause: the assertions pin the internal-link form of newer Pandoc LaTeX writers, `\hyperref[<id>]{...}` (return_links.rs:645-1119). Pandoc 3.1.3 writes internal links as `\protect\hyperlink{<id>}{...}` and wraps headings in `\hypertarget{<id>}{%...}`. Example failure at return_links.rs:739: output contains `\protect\hyperlink{dup-1}{a\BobTag{ᵃ}}` but the test requires `\hyperref[dup-1]`. Production code does not match on either form (only tests do), and the BobReturnAnchor/BobTag/BobBacklinks tagging is present in the output, so this looks test-only.

Fix: make the tests accept both Pandoc link forms (one shared helper such as `has_internal_link(latex, id)`), or declare and check a minimum Pandoc version if `\hyperlink` output is wrong for the PDF. Either way, keep the paired/dead/github report assertions. Precedent: bob-cli-4u fixed a similar Pandoc-version-pinned assertion in create.rs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: 9/9 fail every run on clean trees across three independent runs (bob-cli-5s.1, bob-cli-5s.9 with the phase stashed, bob-cli-5s.land on b6ba7c3), and the cause is a fixed Pandoc writer difference (3.1.3 emits \protect\hyperlink{id} where the tests require \hyperref[id]), not timing.
